  • If someone is attacking you with a knife, run. Get away from the knife. If two guys are holding your arms, and a third guy is moving in to stab you, offer to suck their dicks. Offer your wallet. If you want to survive offer them whatever it is they're after. The odds in that situation are so immensely stacked against you, unless your plan is to die fighting try whatever you can to de-escalate the situation.

Easy to test though: get three friends together. Guys of decent size and strength, have two of them each hold an arm. Take the knife out of the equation. Have the two guys holding the arms really hold them, no bullshitting, no just standing there posing and waiting for your scripted escape moves. Have the third guy start punching you in the guts until you manage to pull free. Spoiler alert, your buddies will stop beating your ass from being tired before you manage to escape, much less mount a successful series of counter moves. Even if you're a guy around the same size/strength as the other three. Even if you know "martial arts" and they don't. This isn't a movie, you aren't Neo.
